name: ferret-checkpointable-runtime-iteration
instr:
Ferret cannot pause iteration and resume from opaque, caller-owned checkpoints without replaying consumed work. Implement this across native iterables, SDK views, and VM-owned collections without changing ordinary iteration.

The `Checkpoint`, `Cursor`, and `Checkpointable` contract in `github.com/MontFerret/ferret/v2/pkg/runtime` must preserve the next logical item across exhaustion, cancellation, and idempotent closure. Closed cursors return `ErrCursorClosed` without values. Malformed, foreign, stale, and unready checkpoints must fail before consuming input through `CheckpointError`, using `ErrInvalidCheckpoint` = "invalid checkpoint", `ErrCheckpointSource` = "checkpoint source mismatch", `ErrCheckpointStale` = "checkpoint source changed", and `ErrCursorNotReady` = "cursor source not ready".

Arrays must preserve indexed keys and shallow identities, reject structural ambiguity, and accept replacement. Canceling an array cursor after checkpointing must not prevent that checkpoint resuming at the next indexed item with a live context. Replacing an element preserves resumability; structural mutation invalidates an ambiguous saved position. Ranges preserve zero-based keys and the remaining arithmetic progress in either direction.
